### Added
- **Progress keeps a tool call alive, up to `spec.progress.maxDuration`.** On a tool call whose caller sent a `progressToken`, every progress notification from the server now restarts `spec.timeout`, up to the new MCPServer field `progress.maxDuration` (seconds, from `timeout` to 3600, default 3600); a call cut at that bound fails with `no answer within the server's progress.maxDuration of …`. Setting it equal to `timeout` turns the extension off for a server. Every other call and operation keeps `spec.timeout` as its whole budget. ([giantswarm/roadmap#4394](https://github.com/giantswarm/roadmap/issues/4394))
